inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject if attention and games cease to drive material economics, regulation or competition impairs monetization, AI spending persistently destroys cash, or ADR/common-share transmission becomes unreliable.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: Tencent can convert games, Weixin attention, advertising, payments and cloud engagement into revenue, margin and cash flow, with AI improving discovery and monetization if compute returns exceed their cost.

objective: Review Tencent's causal relationship to digital attention, gaming and consumer ecosystems.
